summary: Applied all 3 spec-review blocking repairs: stable unitId lookup, impl tooling-failure boundary contract, and retryable WorkUnit failure classification.

items.title: Define stable WorkUnit checkpoint lookup key
items.rationale: The spec now defines `unitId` as a stable lookup key derived from phase, kind, stable order key, and parentUnitId, while full identity remains the stale/reuse comparison input.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[], requirements R2/R3, acceptance criteria R2/R3, clarifications[], overview.decisions[], and T-1 now describe stable unitId lookup and full identity comparison.

items.title: Specify impl tooling-failure runner contract
items.rationale: The spec now requires WorkUnit tooling failures to cross the impl review subprocess boundary as structured `TOOLING_FAILURE` results with no final artifacts, no next-step advancement, and no semantic reviewRetry increment.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[], data_flow[], overview.decisions[], requirements R5/R10, acceptance criteria R5/R10, clarifications[], and T-2 now specify the runner boundary contract.

items.title: Define retryable WorkUnit failure classification
items.rationale: The spec now names retryable WorkUnit failure kinds and excludes checkpoint I/O and invariant failures from fallback splitting.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[], overview.decisions[], requirements R8/R10, acceptance criteria R8/R10, clarifications[], and T-3 now define retryable failureKind mapping.
